message: Ya se asoma otra vez parte del bordillo en Kennedy. Aún queda agua acumulada. #Bogota #inundacion

attachments.alt_text: Synthetic AI-generated original image for post-0019: A quiet close landscape smartphone photo at a low angle in Kennedy, Bogotá after the rain eases: newly exposed upper edge of a concrete curb and a thin fresh muddy waterline on a tan wall, shallow brown water still standing farther into street. A few gravel pebbles and flattened leaves, soft grey reflected sky, no drain, no people, no buildings in wide view. Clearly receding water, not a surging current.
